purpose: Official DACON submission package AS-09 integrating next-generation Bi-Encoder DPR-SYMPHON-02 (SyllableConvBlock, Multi-Query Attention Pooling, Gated Multi-View & Tail Fusion, ANCE/Sister Hard Negatives, CosFace) with full 12,222-row training and complete self-contained package bundling.
hypothesis: Deploying DPR-SYMPHON-02 full-dataset weights and catalog embeddings with complete package dependencies (preventing AS-08 import failure) and high-confidence lexical fallback delivers superior unseen vessel retrieval (+3.77%p Hangul Recall@1, 99.30% non-Hangul Recall@35) and 100% clean Hangul accuracy on heldout data while fully respecting <= 35MB size and row-independence.
changed_factors: DPR-SYMPHON-02 next-generation Bi-Encoder architecture (SyllableConvBlock 1D-CNN + Multi-Query Attention Pooling + Gated Multi-View & Tail Fusion)

Bundled ALL phonetic_encoder package modules (dataset.py, hybrid_matcher.py, loss.py, model.py, retrieval.py, tokenizer.py, __init__.py), completely preventing AS-08 missing loss.py import failure
Enabled fatal configuration assertion in script.py ensuring zero silent fallback
fixed_conditions: Row independence: 100% strict single vs batch inference invariance (LayerNorm-only, zero BatchNorm)
Zero network calls, zero external AI API, zero disk write during test inference
